content.short: Token Terminal is a financial data aggregator targeting blockchains and dApps.
content.description: Token Terminal is a data collection service that gathers financial data from on-chain DeFi protocols and dApps across multiple networks, organizing the information from smart-contract activity. Analysts can assess the value of protocols and projects using the derived financial metrics, enabling meaningful comparisons of growth, profitability, and overall economics. Developers can access the Token Terminal API to retrieve historic fee data from platforms such as Uniswap, enabling more informed revenue analysis and insights into how ecosystems generate value.
